intro.title: Words that lie
intro.body:
Two traps in one unit.
**One Czech word, two English words**: *jídlo* is **meal** (breakfast, lunch) or **dish** (a thing you cook); *půjčit* is **borrow** (you take) or **lend** (you give); *recept* is **recipe** (cooking) or **prescription** (doctor).
**Look-alikes that mean something else**: *aktuální* is **current**, not *actual*; *eventuálně* is **possibly**, not *eventually*; *sympatický* is **likeable**, not *sympathetic*.

intro.title: The pairs to keep apart
frames: meal (jídlo you eat) ≠ dish (jídlo you cook)
teach (the teacher does it) ≠ learn (the student does it)
intro.note: When the gap wants one of a pair, ask WHO does it, or WHERE it happens — that decides.
